text:
Riley H: Draft uploaded — quick lane checks please. Need: headline final, benchmark phrasing, legal-safe residency wording, and webinar/signup routing. Link: docs.redwood/launch-draft.

Sam P: skimmed  headline option: 'Ship predictable inference'  short + punchy. Benchmarks: include concrete numbers and test conditions (hw, batch). e.g., median 230ms, p95 510ms at 1k tokens (A100, batch=8).

Jun K: product asks we add one line about rollout controls (pin versions, canary rollback). Keep it 1 sentence in the hero.

Olivia M: legal: do not use absolutes about data. Replace "we never see inputs" with "customers may choose dedicated deployments or VPC peering for data residency and isolation." Attach eval to /legal/audit before publish.

Riley H: will update residency line and add the rollout sentence. Sam  inserting your benchmark numbers into the technical callout.

Vikram S: CTO quote ready: "Predictability in inference is how teams ship reliably." Use attribution: "	6 Vikram, CTO". Short is fine.

Mara L: ops rec: publish Tue 09:00 PT, webinar Thu 11:00 PT (48h lead time). I'll create HubSpot form with hidden fields campaign=launch_q2_2026 and a checkbox 'send_eval' to trigger eval delivery.

Sam P: agree with timing. Also add form hidden tag campaign_source=blog and list name 'Q2_Launch_2026'.

Olivia M: legal approves the revised residency sentence and the CTO quote, pending eval PDF upload.

Riley H: uploading eval now to /legal/audit/3654321999_eval.pdf and updating hero alt text to 'Redwood Inference dashboard'. Once ops posts the form I'll ask @publish-bot to schedule.

publish-bot: Scheduled: Post 'Ship predictable inference' set to publish 2026-08-10 09:00 PDT. HubSpot webhook created; eval workflow configured for checkbox 'send_eval'.

Riley H: thanks all  final checklist: eval attached, quote in, residency language updated, benchmark box added, ops mapping live. If no objections I'll hit publish on Tuesday. :rocket:
